title: Lighthouse Park Hiking / Horseshoe Bay Discovery Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Pet friendly with private group booking
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Imagine sipping your favorite coffee or tea sitting on the beach/ bluffs at the peaceful Whytecliff Park, watching waves come and go, it does not get any more relaxing than this! If you are lucky, you might spot some seals in the distance. We then take you to the most photographed and recognizable historical spot in the area, Lighthouse Park. Snap those perfect selfie to share with your family or friends.

Our tour includes your favorite coffee/tea at a local café in Horseshoe Bay and transportation from and to your hotels or any place in downtown Vancouver.
